Create the file `case_133.inp` in the working directory with the following content:

Run CalculiX using the command `ccx -i case_133` or `ccx case_133`.
Check the file `case_133.sta` for a successful termination message, such as 'JOB COMPLETED'.
Create a file named `results.json` in the working directory.
The `results.json` file must contain a JSON object with the following key-value pairs:
The "solver" key must have the value "calculix".
The "case_id" key must have the value "case_133".
The "status" key must have the value "success" if the run completed successfully, or "error" otherwise.
The "ccx_version" key must have the version string obtained from running `ccx -v`.
The "artifacts" key must have an empty list as its value.
The "notes" key must contain a string with the exact CalculiX command used to run the simulation.
If the simulation fails, the "notes" string must also include the error message and the name of the file that indicated the failure.
